impact: The fading bounce in Korean memory makers suggests investors are selling strength rather than chasing Nvidia's beat, a caution flag for MU, DRAM and SNXX at the US open.
source: Korea Times / MoneyToday / Seoul Economic Daily
summary: South Korea's Kospi surged 2.97% at the open to 5,115.92 after Nvidia's beat, reclaiming 5,000 a day after closing at 4,968.48 (its first close below 5,000 since February). By late morning, Korea Times reported the index trading slightly lower as retail investors sold into the rally, with Samsung Electronics down 0.4% and SK Hynix up 2.19%, after earlier gains of about 4% and 5%. Samsung Electro-Mechanics rose on a new substrate supply deal with Nvidia.
title: Kospi's Nvidia rally fades: opened up 3%, slipped by late morning
